title: SiestaSMP Modpack
description: Explore, build, and build your home in this cozy world of endless adventure.
body:
This modpack offers new structures and new biomes that makes the adventure more exciting. This also offers new blocks for you builds.

This is a client built for SiestaSMP but still be able to use it as your own modded singleplayer world. It also offers performance boost with [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) mod.

### Core Mods:
- [Biomes O Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty)
- [Oh The Biomes We've Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone)
- [Rechiseled](https://modrinth.com/mod/rechiseled)
- [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeons-and-taverns)

  
_This is recommended to play with friends._

We called it SMP because the modpack works very well on self-hosted server when it's installed in it. Have fun!
